response.sql:
WITH team_averages AS (
    SELECT team_id, AVG(CAST(l AS REAL) / g) AS avg_loss_rate
    FROM manager_half
    WHERE g > 53 AND g IS NOT NULL AND l IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY team_id
)
SELECT AVG(avg_loss_rate) AS average_of_team_averages
FROM team_averages;

assumptions.assumption: “Pass the 53-game mark” means strictly more than 53 games; team averages group stints by team_id across all years, and missing losses or games are excluded.
